description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Queen City conducted an educational session at Lady Engineer High School, Tardeo, on 17th August 2026 for X Board–appearing students.

Rtn. Prof. Shailendra Khandelwal guided the students on managing examination stress, overcoming the fear of exams, and preparing Science and Maths effectively. The session also focused on making studies more interesting and reducing dependence on rote learning.

The event was an enriching and motivating experience for the students, encouraging them to approach their examinations with greater confidence and a positive mindset.
location: Lady Engineer High School, MUMBAI, Maharashtra
